expectations.text: Places Cuba in Country Group E:2 (unilateral embargo), not E:1

expectations.text: Places Russia and Belarus in Country Groups D:1-D:5 (subject to the 746.8 sanctions), not in Group E

expectations.text: States A:2 = Missile Technology Control Regime adherents and A:3 = Australia Group
